notes: INSIDE half of the Basalt Quarry Driver: a hydraulic ram whose piston head draws back as it charges (frame 5 = fully drawn, spring glowing, strip yellow), a round rock slug waiting in the cradle, iron-strapped stone housing, power coupling, hatch. fire: the piston slams forward and the cradle is empty. damaged: the ram cylinder cracked and leaking magma, slits dead; disabled: the piston jammed half way, a slug cracked in two. Barrel layer basalt_quarry_driver_barrel: a long thick stone barrel with three iron collars; fire: the slug leaves in a flash and the breech vents flame.
